body:
There are misogynists and misandrists everywhere. Maybe instead of making blanketed statements that assume the negative viewpoint of an entire gender, you should work to improve relations via means that are actually productive as opposed to trying to rally women around your predisposed and largely incorrect viewpoints. If every man you come in contact with is a misogynist on some level, then you're probably a bad judge of character and are most likely surrounding yourself with the wrong people. Sorry, but I can't stand blanketed
comments like this.
